_note: The guild's own schedule, as data so the site can read it — the Scroll of Events was hand-written HTML, which meant nothing could say what is happening next. `at` is a rough hour in Las Vegas local time, used only to work out which event is next; the words people read are `when`. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-events.js

events.title: Campfire & S'mores
events.body: The fire is lit and the marshmallows are toasted — the weekend begins.

events.title: Guild Potluck & Drinks
events.body: Bring a dish to share; drinks by the firelight as the night comes on.

events.title: After-Party Faire Stroll
events.body: A rough jaunt through the faire grounds after closing time to seek out new members and adventures.

events.title: Guild Dinner
events.body: The big camp meal, cooked up proper.

events.title: Drinks & Tales
events.body: The long night of drinking and stories by the camp.

events.title: After-Party Faire Stroll
events.body: Round two through the grounds — recruiting and revelling after the gates shut.

events.title: Camp Breakfast
events.body: Meat and eggs cooked up at camp (no campfire tonight) — fuel for the final day.

events.title: Last Call
events.body: One last round together before the gates close. Raise a cup to the weekend.

events.title: The Gates Close
events.body: Pack the camp, take the tales home.
